messages:
alex: Quick infra/contract Q — I'm putting up a small API opt-in for rerank tie handling, need fast sync on backcompat & rollout. PR in thread below.

maria: what exactly are you changing vs current behavior? :thinking:

alex: current: equal scores or missing scores preserve input order. proposed: add optional tie_policy enum on the request: 'legacy' (default), 'hash', 'timestamp', 'random'. also add optional client_seed string for client-controlled deterministic tie ordering.

kevin: leaving default as 'legacy' sounds safe. we must ensure no SDK auto-opts into new behavior.

alex: yes — strict opt-in. server only applies new tie logic when tie_policy != 'legacy' or client_seed is present.

june: what about null / absent scores? some callers send score:null to indicate unscored and rely on input order.

alex: plan for that: number scores sort desc. null/absent treated as missing and rank after numeric scores. within missing group, apply tie_policy. If tie_policy=legacy => preserve input order among ties/missings.

alex: hash details: with tie_policy=hash and item_id present, compute SHA1(item_id + seed) and use that ascending as tie-breaker. if item lacks item_id, fall back to input order and log a single warning per request.

maria: can you paste a sample request/response so docs are clear?

alex: sure — example:

```
POST /v1/rerank
{
  "model": "rwd/reranker-v2",
  "items": [
    {"item_id": "p1", "text": "...", "score": 0.82},
    {"item_id": "p2", "text": "...", "score": 0.82},
    {"item_id": "p3", "text": "...", "score": null}
  ],
  "tie_policy": "hash",
  "client_seed": "campaign-42"
}

# response
{
  "items": [
    {"item_id": "p2", "score": 0.82, "rank": 1},
    {"item_id": "p1", "score": 0.82, "rank": 2},
    {"item_id": "p3", "score": null, "rank": 3}
  ],
  "tie_policy_used": "hash"
}
```

kevin: exposing tie_policy_used in the response is helpful for telemetry.

june: I'll add unit tests for hash determinism and missing-id fallback, also integration tests for canary.

alex: PR checklist: openapi/SDK updates, default stays legacy, warn once per request if hash requested and missing item_id, tie_policy_used in response, e2e canary test comparing legacy vs hash with same seed, docs + migration guide.

maria: rollout suggestion: merge behind feature flag; docs + SDK samples ready; 1% canary 48h; check ordering histograms & warnings; then 25% then broader. no default flip.

alex: agreed. adding deprecation note that if we flip default later requires 90-day notice and compat_mode param, but not doing that now.

kevin: edge case: duplicate item_ids. with hash we get same hash; final tie-breaker should preserve original input order.

alex: yep final comparator chain: (1) numeric score desc, (2) present before missing, (3) tie resolver per tie_policy (legacy=input order, hash=sha1(item_id+seed), timestamp=created_at if provided, random=server-random but seeded per request), (4) if still tied preserve input order.

june: i'll own tests. adding coverage for empty items list, missing item_id with hash, duplicate ids, and seed reproducibility.

alex: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — PTAL @maria @kevin @june. If no objections by EOD I'll merge behind flag and kick off canary.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled (flag: rerank.tie_policy_optin) — 1% traffic starting in 30m :rocket:

maria: LGTM, small docs nit (explicitly show score: null). I'll open a tiny docs PR.

kevin: review incoming in ~1h. ping me if you want staging flag enabled for ad-hoc tests.

alex: action items: june: tests & canary checks; kevin: review; maria: docs; alex: merge behind flag & monitor.

alex: marking resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
